caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a baby carriage or pram. The carriage has a green body with lighter green or gold accents along its edges and contours. Attached to the body on the left side are two long curved handles that are tan or light brown in color. The seat and backrest area have a black fabric or material draped over them. The carriage is supported by three large, spoked wheels, also tan or light brown with some shading for depth, and one smaller, spoked wheel at the rear. The background of the drawing is an unadorned, light beige or cream color. In the lower right corner, the name "Richard Barnett" is written in black text.
title: Doll Buggy
